description: This Perl module defines the TestDB class, which extends DBICx::TestDatabase, providing methods for initializing a test database with test data, executing SQL statements from a file, and performing install and upgrade tests. It includes class methods, package functions, and references external modules related to database deployment and testing.

classes.name: TestDB
classes.description: A test database class extending DBICx::TestDatabase, providing methods to initialize with test data and execute SQL scripts.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes a new TestDB instance, optionally loading test data from 'share/test_data.sql'.

methods.name: execute_test_data
methods.description: Executes SQL statements from a specified file, typically 'share/test_data.sql', on the provided schema.

methods.name: install_ok
methods.description: Performs an installation test for the schema, optionally specifying a version and name.

methods.name: upgrade_ok
methods.description: Performs an upgrade test for the schema to a specified version, optionally with a name.
